bull_bear.body: Net cash position of Rs.31 Cr; Final dividend recommended at Rs.4.15/share; M&A on hold for immediate future, evaluating only unique tech opportunities in medium term.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Elongated client decision cycles for AI projects; BFSI sector contraction pressures; Domestic channel policy changes by OEMs (Microsoft); Sustainability of TMT upturn.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Cautiously optimistic; disciplined execution; focused on continuity during leadership transition; confident in AI pipeline conversion despite macro headwinds.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: AI-led orders now 18% of total book indicating rapid product mix shift; Domestic business already recovered most of the OEM direct-billing loss within 4 quarters despite reported degrowth; 90% of workforce already AI-certified creating a latent margin lever if utilization dips.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- 'Declared interim dividend of 125% per share' (deck's own wording, stated alongside the Q1FY27 financial highlights).
- Consolidated balance-sheet position at Q1'27: 'Gross Cash and Cash Equivalent' 567.0 INR crs and 'Cash & net cash position' 67.0 INR crs - the latter having moved from -62.5 in Q1'26 and -280.0 in Q2'26 to 30.7 in Q4'26.
- Working capital in the domestic arm loosened sharply - 'Net working capital/GC' at 0.87 in Q1'27 versus 0.48 in Q4'26 and 0.45 in Q2'26/Q3'26, with domestic DSO at 65 days versus 47 in Q4'26.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: International: Revenue Rs.779.2 Cr (+5.5% QoQ), EBITDA 20.2%. Domestic: Revenue Rs.1,759.2 Cr (-25% QoQ, -8.3% YoY) due to channel disruption; PAT Rs.46.3 Cr (+3.9% QoQ).

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Stated positioning is a three-part construct: 'Outcome-led Business Transformation', 'AI-first Technology Platforms' and 'AI-native Service Delivery', summarised as 'Engineering the AI enterprise'.
- Named capabilities under that umbrella: 'Domain-driven customer-enabling operations', 'Legacy Modernization', 'AI-ready data', 'Resilient AI command center', 'AI-powered engineering' and 'Autonomous ops'.
- Go-to-market is 'Micro vertical focused' across BFS, HLS, RMD and 'Tech and emerging'; the deck's four vertical labels are TMT (Technology, Media and Telecom), BFSI, HLS (Healthcare and Life Sciences) and RMD (Retail, Manuf., Travel and Distribution).
- The Microsoft relationship is presented as the core moat: 'Microsoft-Sonata 360 Degree Partnership: 30+ Years', with '3500+ Team On Microsoft Technologies', 'Annual $650M+ MSFT Annual Revenue Tied to the Microsoft Stack', '400+ Clients Across The Globe', Azure Expert MSP status, '10 Advanced Specialization in Dynamics 365, Data Analytics, Teams, CAF, M365, Azure' and 'Microsoft AI Council Partner Member'.
- Ecosystem is stated as broader than Microsoft: '360 ecosystem partnerships - Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, Servicenow'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Two-business structure] The deck reports International Services and Domestic Business separately with radically different economics - the Domestic Business (SITL) shows Q1'27 revenue of 2505.6 INR crs against Gross Contribution of just 78.5 INR crs and EBITDA (Before Forex & OI) margin of 2.4%, consistent with its 'Grow Core Reselling/Platform' description; International Services shows Q1'27 revenue of 777.2 INR crs on a 15.4% EBITDA (Before Forex & OI) margin. Gross revenue of the reselling arm is not comparable to services revenue.
- [Client concentration] Revenue from Top 10 clients fell to 51.0% in Q1'27 from 54.0% in Q4'26 and 56% in Q1'26; Top 20 was 70.0% versus 69.0% in Q4'26. New customers added: 7 in Q1'27, same as Q4'26 and Q1'26.
- [Client-size cohorts] $5+ Mn clients numbered 12 in Q1'27 (13 in Q1'26), $3-5 Mn 9 (6), $1-3 Mn 32 (39) - the small-account cohort has been shrinking through the five quarters shown.
- [Geography mix] International Services revenue by geography at Q1'27: USA 71%, Europe 23%, ROW 6% - Europe has risen from 16.0% in Q1'26 while ROW fell from 10.0%.
- [Disclosure change] The covering letter describes the file as a 'revised Investors' Presentation for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026', i.e. a restatement of an earlier submission; the deck does not say what was revised.

deepdive.thesis: Sonata delivered resilient Q4FY26 with 20.2% EBITDA margins driven by AI-enabled utilization (91.8%) despite flat international revenue, while domestic business stabilized post-OEM direct-billing shock. The appointment of Rajsekhar Datta Roy (30-year veteran/AI-architect) as CEO signals an aggressive pivot to monetize the $280M AI pipeline, targeting BFSI and TMT recovery in FY27.

open.item: AI-enabled Services are expected to contribute 20% of the Company's revenue by the end of FY27.
The investment verticals Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS) and Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) are stated to be on track to scale to $250M in revenue over the next 3 to 5 years.

open.horizon: subject to approval at the ensuing AGM
open.item: The Directors have recommended a final dividend of Rs. 4.15 per equity share (415% on a par value of Rs. 1 each), in addition to interim dividends already declared, subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing AGM.
Large-deal pursuits remain a cornerstone of the growth strategy, with approximately 40% of the pipeline comprising large, strategic opportunities.

The India business (SITL) is being built on three strategic pillars — expanding the Microsoft channel with sharper focus on the SMC segment, broadening partnerships with other ISVs beyond the three hyperscaler CSP partnerships, and winning large System Integration deals integrating Cisco, IBM, Dell and other ISV infrastructures with leading cloud platforms.

The India business (SITL) will be grown on three strategic pillars — expanding the Microsoft channel with sharper focus on the SMC segment including incubation of the new Sonata-on-Cloud (SoC) offering, broadening partnerships with other ISVs beyond the three hyperscale CSPs, and winning large System Integration deals.
Under Program Edge, immigration management and compensation and benefits administration are on the road to be fully automated with an AI layer on top, to drive efficiencies and governance.

The India business (SITL) is expanding along three pillars — Microsoft channel expansion into the SMC segment, broader ISV partnerships beyond the three hyperscaler CSPs, and large System Integration deals integrating Cisco, IBM, Dell and other ISV infrastructures with leading cloud platforms.

risks.note: Flagged as a material risk in the BRSR: Sonata is a people-centric organisation and its sustained success is closely tied to its ability to attract, engage and retain highly skilled technology professionals; as the global shift toward digital transformation intensifies, the growing imbalance in skilled talent has become increasingly evident. Mitigation runs through engagement initiatives, the DNA (Deep Nurtured Attributes) core values and a rewards and recognition framework.
risks.risk: Human capital development, retention and labour practices

risks.note: Flagged as a material risk in the BRSR: the expansion of operations along with increased adoption of remote working models may elevate the risk of data breaches; any failure to ensure data privacy or to report incidents in a timely manner could result in legal penalties, reputational damage with clients and potential financial exposure. Mitigated by certification audits for the Information Security Management Framework aligned with ISO 27001 and the Service Management Framework aligned with ISO 20000, plus security investments, access controls, threat monitoring and employee awareness training.
risks.risk: Privacy protection and cybersecurity / data breach exposure

risks.note: Flagged as a material risk and opportunity in the BRSR: climate-related risks are increasingly impacting the operational environment and financial performance, and possible implementation of carbon taxation in the near term could influence the growth trajectory; transitioning to a low-carbon economy may require substantial upfront investment.
risks.risk: Climate change — climate risk, GHG emissions and possible carbon taxation

risks.note: Flagged as a material risk and opportunity in the BRSR: full legal compliance must be maintained and internal practices constantly updated to stay ahead of changing regulations; implementing high governance standards requires significant resources, described as a negative but mitigated financial impact and a vital investment for maintaining stakeholder confidence.
risks.risk: Corporate governance and business ethics / regulatory compliance burden

risks.note: Customer relationships are central to Sonata's business strategy and the growth of the customer base is closely aligned with the rate at which organisations adopt digital transformation initiatives — making revenue growth a function of external enterprise IT spending cycles.
risks.risk: Dependence on the pace of client digital-transformation adoption

risks.note: The North America business now represents over 74% of total revenue, up from approximately 54% three years ago, so demand or client conditions in a single market drive the bulk of the business; exports contribute 39% of the entity's total turnover.
risks.risk: Geographic revenue concentration in North America

risks.note: The BRSR reports one business activity — Information Technology Services and Solutions (IT consultancy, computer programming, modernization, testing support) — at more than 90% of turnover, with computer programming, consultancy and related activities at 100% of turnover, leaving no diversification outside IT services.

Growth is concentrated in a set of explicit bets — AI-enabled services scaling to a stated share of revenue, large-deal pursuits, and the HLS and BFSI invest verticals — which depend on continued AI adoption by clients and on sustaining hyperscaler partner status (Microsoft Inner Circle/Frontier/Fabric, AWS Premier Tier and Gen AI Competency) rather than on a diversified base.
risks.risk: Execution risk on the AI-led pivot
